name: Tsukumo SNAP!
summary: 夏日小镇像素冒险 RPG，2026 年 10 月 27 日上架，ISEKAI Games 开发并发行，分类为冒险／独立／角色扮演：主角 Haru 在忘町外婆家过暑假最后一周，储物间纸箱里一台闲置十二年的黄色翻盖手机自己开机，里面住着永远只剩 4% 电量的毒舌 AI「Denpa」，也是唯一能看见付丧神——那些在被遗忘物件里成形的灵——的存在。商店 AI 披露称本作含 AI 工具协助创作的内容，具体点名编程与视觉素材，并以“其他创作要素”收尾，另称所有生成内容都经开发者审阅、编辑与整合。本站据此把代码与美术登记为已使用，其余六个领域因披露没有点名而登记为未说明。需要区分：游戏设定里那个会说话的 AI 角色属叙事内容，与制作端是否使用 AI 无关。第三方转录页面的分领域等级不采纳。所有结论只有开发者自述支撑，未经独立审计。

english.summary: A pixel adventure RPG released on Oct 27, 2026, developed and published by ISEKAI Games and filed under Adventure, Indie and RPG, in which Haru spends the last week of summer at grandmas house in the Forgotten Town, a yellow flip phone left twelve years in a cardboard box switches itself on, and inside it lives Denpa, a sarcastic AI frozen at 4 percent battery and the only thing that can see the tsukumogami spirits growing inside objects people stopped caring about. The Steam AI disclosure says the game contains content created with the assistance of AI tools, names programming and visual assets, ends with other creative elements and adds that all generated content was reviewed, edited and integrated by the developer. This site records code and art as used, treats that closing catch all as unassignable so the remaining six areas stay not addressed, notes that the talking AI character is part of the fiction rather than evidence about production, and does not adopt the aggregator area grades. Every finding rests on the developer own statement without independent audit.
english.reviewNote: Checked the complete English Steam AI disclosure block, covering programming, visual assets and the other creative elements tail, plus the identity with ISEKAI Games as both developer and publisher on a full release dated Oct 27, 2026. The English discussion board shows 0 visible topics out of 0 in total, so this title has no public threads and no community dispute could be read. One dedicated web search was run, archived as press-search.json with 6 results, and one source was registered and read in full, the HowMuchAI entry page for this game, whose verbatim transcription matches the store text while its area grades are automatic third party judgements this site does not adopt. A GameAICheck publisher statistics page claiming that all 20 titles from this publisher disclose AI use was also fetched and read in full but is a developer level summary without this disclosure text, so it is not registered as a source. Of the remaining results one was a localised store page already covered by the official evidence, one a field filtered listing page, one IndieDB Next Fest demo announcement that answered HTTP 403 through the relay, and one ModDB data page that was not fetched and does not carry the Steam disclosure field. No independent reporting was found, the closing other creative elements cannot be assigned to a discipline, and every finding rests on the developer own statement without independent audit.
